A '''long-tailed''', four-legged '''creature''' was found on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was sleeping in a tree until it was awoken by the sound of [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] teaching [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] to use magic, and it was visibly started by the noise.<ref name="Episode" />
